subject.title: fix(agents): stop runs at the critical tool-loop threshold

question: Should the existing Codex `loopDetectionPreToolUseRelay: false` setting intentionally disable both the loop-detection-only PreToolUse marker and the new PostToolUse outcome relay for existing configurations?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive interpretation of an existing user setting: the PR documents the behavior, but it changes which future loop-detection observations are available to users who already opted out of the PreToolUse relay.

options.title: Confirm the combined opt-out
options.body: Accept the documented contract that `false` disables both loop-detection relay directions, then merge after the exact-head required checks pass.

options.title: Split the opt-out semantics
options.body: Keep the existing switch limited to PreToolUse and introduce a separately reviewed mechanism for suppressing PostToolUse loop observations.

options.title: Pause for Codex owner review
options.body: Hold the PR until the Codex runtime owner confirms the intended long-term configuration contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm the combined opt-out
recommendation.body: Accept the documented contract that `false` disables both loop-detection relay directions, then merge after the exact-head required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the original observed failure and expected termination behavior; a current Codex runtime owner should join the decision if available.
